description: This file contains Swift source code defining UI components, caching, rate-limiting mechanisms, and network interactions related to session preview functionalities within a macOS application. It includes data models, view components, asynchronous cache management, and network request handling for session previews.

classes.name: SessionPreviewItem
classes.description: Model representing a preview item in a session, identified by id, with assigned role and text.

classes.name: PreviewRole
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible roles of preview items, with associated label properties.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: Actor managing cached session preview snapshots with methods to retrieve and store snapshots.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: Actor controlling concurrent access to session preview requests, implementing rate-limiting.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewSnapshot
classes.description: Data structure encapsulating session preview items and loading status.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewView
classes.description: SwiftUI view component that renders the session preview UI based on items and status.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewLoader
classes.description: Static class providing methods for preloading and fetching session preview snapshots asynchronously.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieve a cached session preview snapshot if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Store a session preview snapshot into cache for a given session key.

methods.name: lastSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieve the last stored snapshot for a session key.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Execute an async operation while respecting concurrency limits, acquiring and releasing permits.

methods.name: _testSet
methods.description: Test method to set cache entries directly (debug only).

methods.name: _testReset
methods.description: Test method to reset cache entries (debug only).

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preload session preview snapshots for multiple session keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load a session preview snapshot, returning cached if available, otherwise fetching.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetch a session preview snapshot via network, falling back to history if needed.

methods.name: requestPreview
methods.description: Send network request to fetch preview data for given session keys.

methods.name: fetchHistorySnapshot
methods.description: Fetch a snapshot from chat history network request.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Construct a session preview snapshot from items or entries.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Cache a set of payload preview entries into the cache.

methods.name: previewLimit
methods.description: Determine the limit of items for preview based on maxItems.

methods.name: normalizeMaxItems
methods.description: Normalize the maxItems parameter within bounds.

methods.name: previewItems
methods.description: Generate preview items from payload or entries, respecting maxItems.

methods.name: decodeMessages
methods.description: Decode raw message data into structured chat messages.

methods.name: previewRole
methods.description: Determine the PreviewRole for a message from raw role string.

methods.name: previewRoleFromRaw
methods.description: Convert raw role string to PreviewRole enum.

methods.name: previewText
methods.description: Generate preview text from a chat message.

methods.name: isToolCall
methods.description: Detect if a message is a tool call.

methods.name: toolNames
methods.description: Gather tool names involved in a message.

methods.name: mediaSummary
methods.description: Generate a media type summary from a message.

methods.name: dedupePreservingOrder
methods.description: Remove duplicates from a list while preserving order.

methods.name: uniqueKeys
methods.description: Deduplicate session keys after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isUnknownMethodError
methods.description: Check if an error indicates an unknown method error in network response.
